{{Top|leg}}
'''Raynor Mining Enterprises''' was a prospecting and mining corporation that existed during the time of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]]. Founded by [[Trebold Raynor]], the company was somewhat notorious for their strategy of buying a [[Planet/Legends|planet]], harvesting all available resources, (whether they be [[Mineral/Legends|mineral]], [[Ore/Legends|ore]], or [[Crystal/Legends|crystal]]) and then abandoning it.<ref name="guide">''[[Shadows of the Empire Planets Guide]]''</ref>

After detailed surveys, that showed ore reserves worth of centuries, they decided to purchase [[Kothlis/Legends|Kothlis]] in order to make permanent settlements. Raynor outbid the Bothans who wanted the planet for a colony.<ref name="guide" />  

Clans of [[Ugnaught/Legends|Ugnaughts]] were imported as manual workers, and built the first installations on the planet: a temporary facility and a [[Abandoned smelting plant|smelting plant]] at the eastern feet of the [[Ragnook Mountains]]. Most of the millions of [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] funded the construction of a huge [[metal/Legends|metallic]] platform near the production centers, in order to build a mega-[[city/Legends|city]] on it.<ref name="guide" /> 

However the ore reserves unexpectedly ran out, raising questions about the initial surveys. Chaos spread throughout the company, struggling to consolidate its resources. Two [[standard year/Legends|years]] of floundering led to bankruptcy. This gave the Bothans the opportunity to purchase exclusive rights to Kothlis, after paying off Raynor's debts. All this was a fraction of the initial cost, and the Bothans took advantage of the installations and the workers to [[Tal'cara|complete the city]] and establish a colony.<ref name="guide" />
